row.evidence: Cleverbridge's docs offer SAML SSO set up with Client Experience, with each SCM user added by hand under Settings > Users (SSO Email Address); no SCIM is documented.
row.notes: Merchant-of-record platform with custom transaction-based pricing (quote only, no per-user plans). SAML SSO (SP-initiated) for the SCM admin console and docs is configured with Cleverbridge Client Experience using a custom SAML app in Entra ID or Okta; users are created and deleted manually in SCM Settings > Users and mapped by SSO email. Docs mention that 'batch user provisioning' may be available on request for large teams, but no SCIM endpoint is documented. The developer API (REST/GraphQL) covers carts, subscriptions and purchases, with no SCM user-management endpoints. Not listed in the Okta catalogue (okta.com/integrations/cleverbridge/ 404) or as an Entra tutorial.

plans.name: Custom (transaction-based)
plans.price_text: Custom pricing; Cleverbridge takes a cut of each transaction
plans.notes: SSO plan gating is not stated; SSO is arranged with Client Experience.

scim.notes: No SCIM in the docs sitemap or API reference; SSO users are mapped by hand in SCM.

user_api.notes: dev.cleverbridge.com documents commerce APIs (cart, subscription, purchase, session URLs); an 'API User' privilege grants API access, but no SCM user, privilege or role endpoints are documented.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/cleverbridge/ returns 404; Cleverbridge's guide points to Okta's generic SAML integration flow.

entra.notes: Custom SAML app per Cleverbridge's guide; no Entra tutorial (cleverbridge-tutorial 404).

fallbacks.other_sync: Batch user provisioning may be arranged with Client Experience or a Technical Account Manager (not self-serve)
